mod.overview: 420Snipers Beta ({420}Ice-Dragon, 2002-2003) strips Medium/Heavy armors and disables jetpacks completely (jetForce = 0) on a 20 m/s ground-sprint Sniper class, converting every Base gun slot into sniper rifles, railguns, and high-power lasers.
notes: No-jet ground sniping (ArmorData.cs): removes MediumArmor and HeavyArmor; renames LightArmor to 'Sniper' with 20 m/s speed in all directions (was 11/10/10), 100 energy (was 60), and disabled jets (jetForce = 0, maxJetForwardVelocity = 0).

Total arsenal conversion: Blaster becomes 'Ice Laser' (Mortar-damage beam, 1.0 s beam); Chaingun becomes 'Flesh Eater' (0.5 s reload, sniper model); PlasmaGun becomes 'Predetor' (custom fire handler); GrenadeLauncher becomes ballistic 'Sniper Rifle'; Mortar becomes '420 Rifle'; DiscLauncher becomes 'Heavy Metal' (energy bullet, 0.25 damage); LaserRifle becomes 'Bloody Tears' (100 energy, 1.0 s beam); ELF Gun becomes a 1.0 DPS / 50 m / 100-drain beam.

LightArmor.summary: Renamed 'Sniper'; ground speed raised to 20 m/s in every direction, maxEnergy raised to 100, and jetForce zeroed (no jetting).
notes: MediumArmor and HeavyArmor are removed; players spawn with GrenadeLauncher, Mortar, and PlasmaGun.

Blaster.summary: Converted to 'Ice Laser' (sniper model, 100 maxEnergy, 1.0 s MortarDamageType beam).

Chaingun.summary: Renamed 'Flesh Eater' firing custom 'flesh' projectiles at 0.5 s reload using the sniper model.

PlasmaGun.summary: Renamed 'Predetor' using script-side PlasmaGunImage::onFire with Pred Mags (cap 60).
notes: Static projectileType removed in favor of scripted fire.

GrenadeLauncher.summary: Converted into ballistic 'Sniper Rifle' firing Sniper1 bullets with EnergyDamageType instead of lobbed grenades.

Mortar.summary: Converted into '420 Rifle' firing accelerated Sniper2 rounds at 0.8 s reload on all Sniper spawns.

DiscLauncher.summary: Converted into 'Heavy Metal' firing direct-hit EnergyDamageType HM bullets (0.25 damage, no splash/acceleration).

LaserRifle.summary: Renamed 'Bloody Tears' with 100 maxEnergy (was 60) and 1.0 s beamTime (was 0.5 s).
notes: Custom red lightning beam bitmap and mount handlers.

EnergyRifle.summary: Converted into a heavy 1.0 damagePerSec beam (was 0.06) reaching 50 m and draining 100 energy/sec.
notes: Uses the mortargun shape with 1.0 beamWidth.
